ex.zh: 我們必須為後代保育森林。

ex.zh: 我想要一輛有冷氣的小型車。

ex.zh: 他和所有同事都相處得很好。

ex.zh: 我真的很喜歡我的同事。

ex.zh: 你方便的時候過來喝杯茶吧。

ex.zh: 草莓樹是這個地區常見的景觀植物。

ex.zh: 這筆交易取決於董事會是否核准。

ex.en: Your bonus is contingent on meeting your sales target.
ex.zh: 你的獎金取決於是否達成業績目標。

ex.en: A large contingent of fans traveled to the final.
ex.zh: 一大批球迷遠道去看決賽。

ex.en: The Taiwanese contingent arrived yesterday.
ex.zh: 台灣代表團昨天抵達。

ex.en: The consignment of laptops arrived this morning.
ex.zh: 那批筆電今天早上到貨了。

ex.en: Each consignment must have a delivery note.
ex.zh: 每批貨都要附上送貨單。

ex.en: The shop sells second-hand clothes on consignment.
ex.zh: 這家店寄賣二手衣。

ex.en: She left her paintings at the gallery on consignment.
ex.zh: 她把畫作寄放在畫廊寄賣。

ex.en: The buyer made a counteroffer of 90,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 買方還價九萬美元。

ex.en: We are considering their counteroffer.
ex.zh: 我們正在考慮他們的反提案。

ex.en: This patient's condition is getting worse day by day.
ex.zh: 這病人的情況一天比一天糟。

ex.en: Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上高速公路上的交通狀況正常。

ex.en: Please write to me about conditions at your school.
ex.zh: 請寫信告訴我你們學校的狀況。

ex.en: You can borrow my car on one condition: drive carefully.
ex.zh: 你可以借我的車，但有一個條件：小心開。

ex.en: The loan has strict conditions.
ex.zh: 這筆貸款的條件很嚴格。

ex.en: Both sides made concessions to reach an agreement.
ex.zh: 雙方都做了讓步才達成協議。

ex.en: We are not willing to make any more concessions.
ex.zh: 我們不願意再做任何讓步。

ex.en: Students can get a concession on train tickets.
ex.zh: 學生搭火車可以享有優惠票價。

ex.en: There are concessions for seniors and children.
ex.zh: 長者和兒童有優惠價。

ex.en: He conceded that he had made a mistake.
ex.zh: 他承認自己犯了錯。

ex.en: I concede that the plan has some problems.
ex.zh: 我承認這個計畫有些問題。

ex.en: England’s goalkeeper was criticized for the amount of goals he conceded.
ex.zh: 英格蘭的守門員因為失球太多而被批評。

ex.en: The company conceded a few points to close the deal.
ex.zh: 公司讓步了幾項條件，才把交易談成。

ex.en: This company and I have signed a three-year contract.
ex.zh: 我和這家公司簽了三年的合約。

ex.en: You must look over the contract before you sign it.
ex.zh: 簽約前你一定要仔細看過合約。

ex.en: The union and the company have agreed upon a new contract.
ex.zh: 工會和公司談妥了新的合約。

ex.en: He contracted malaria while traveling in Africa.
ex.zh: 他在非洲旅行時感染了瘧疾。

ex.en: Many people contracted the virus last winter.
ex.zh: 去年冬天很多人感染了這種病毒。

ex.en: Metal contracts when it gets cold.
ex.zh: 金屬遇冷會收縮。

ex.en: The muscles contract when you lift something heavy.
ex.zh: 舉重物時肌肉會收縮。

ex.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
ex.zh: 有些海灘沒有遵守環保規定。

ex.en: Hopefully you'll comply with traffic regulations after this.
ex.zh: 希望你以後會遵守交通規則。

ex.en: Not complying with the naming conventions will result in parse errors.
ex.zh: 不遵守命名規則會導致解析錯誤。

ex.en: My colleague arranged the work files for me.
ex.zh: 同事幫我整理好了工作檔案。

ex.en: We have a colleague in Australia.
ex.zh: 我們在澳洲有一位同事。

ex.en: Lucy and I are not colleagues, we are classmates.
ex.zh: 我和露西不是同事，是同學。

ex.en: Tom is waiting for you in the conference room.
ex.zh: 湯姆在會議室等你。

ex.en: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
ex.zh: 請於下午兩點半到二樓會議室開會。

ex.en: The board will convene next Monday to discuss the budget.
ex.zh: 董事會將於下週一召開會議討論預算。

ex.en: The manager convened an emergency meeting.
ex.zh: 經理召開了一場緊急會議。

ex.en: Worrying doesn't take away tomorrow's concerns, but it does take away today's power.
ex.zh: 煩惱帶不走明天的憂慮，卻會帶走今天的力量。

ex.en: I have some concerns about the budget.
ex.zh: 我對預算有些疑慮。

ex.en: Don't interfere with matters that do not concern you!
ex.zh: 不要干預不關你的事！

ex.en: Tom always meddles in affairs that do not concern him.
ex.zh: 湯姆總是插手跟他無關的事。

concern.zh: as far as I'm concerned：就我而言

ex.en: As far as I'm concerned, things are going well.
ex.zh: 就我而言，事情進行得很順利。

ex.en: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.
ex.zh: 對我來說，她完全是個陌生人。

ex.en: After a long discussion, we finally reached a consensus.
ex.zh: 經過長時間討論，我們終於達成了共識。

ex.en: There is no consensus on how to solve the problem.
ex.zh: 對於如何解決這個問題，大家還沒有共識。

ex.en: Please keep all correspondence with the client in this folder.
ex.zh: 請把和客戶往來的信件都放在這個資料夾裡。

ex.en: We have been in correspondence for several months.
ex.zh: 我們已經通信好幾個月了。

ex.en: I want to quickly confirm my flight again.
ex.zh: 我想再確認一下我的航班。

ex.en: We will confirm your order as follows.
ex.zh: 您的訂單確認如下。

ex.en: The news confirmed my suspicions.
ex.zh: 這個消息證實了我的懷疑。

ex.en: However, all these data were not confirmed.
ex.zh: 不過，這些資料都還沒有得到證實。

ex.en: The staff were courteous and helpful.
ex.zh: 工作人員有禮貌又樂於幫忙。

ex.en: Please send a courteous reply to the customer.
ex.zh: 請給客戶一個客氣的回覆。

ex.en: Your cover letter should explain why you want the job.
ex.zh: 你的求職信應該說明你為什麼想要這份工作。

ex.en: Keep your cover letter to one page.
ex.zh: 求職信控制在一頁以內。

ex.en: I've been told that you're a very competent person.
ex.zh: 有人說你是個很有能力的人。

ex.en: We need competent leaders.
ex.zh: 我們需要稱職的領導人。

ex.en: They are both very competent judges.
ex.zh: 他們倆都是很稱職的法官。
